Aligning the sequences with different species allows us to examine the sequences of the gene and determine if the mutation is important by locating it in other species. As evolution and natural selection made that mutation continued. 

If the mutation in homo sapiens is located in other species it means that it could be important, it has a beneficial function and importance in the structure of the protein or its activity. Having that amino acid was relevant for the structure that a couple of species have the same. 

If the other species have the wild-type amino acid a change might bring out a malfunction,affect the stability of the protein and cause the disease. However, we would need further investigation to determine certainly if it brings the disease or not.
